patterns.note: Full-screen, immersive hero sections dominate the page, transitioning between distinct product visuals and backgrounds on scroll.
A large, vertically oriented display serif typeface is used as a central, persistent visual element across different hero sections.
Predominantly dark, almost black backgrounds are contrasted with vibrant, multi-color product lighting and subtle, ethereal background gradients.

Scrolling triggers full-screen transitions between different hero content slides, where product imagery and background visuals are swapped, while a large vertical text element remains a visual anchor.
The homepage is structured as a series of full-screen, scrollable hero slides, indicated by a numerical progress counter (e.g., '01', '05').

technique_notes: The site employs a full-page scroll-jacking effect, likely powered by locomotive-scroll, where vertical scrolling transitions the user between distinct full-screen hero sections rather than revealing content below the fold. Each section presents new product visuals and background treatments.
Large, vertically oriented display text is used as a persistent visual motif, often remaining in a fixed position or subtly parallaxing as the background and product imagery transition around it.
Product photography is dramatically lit with dynamic, multi-color gradients against dark backgrounds to create a high-contrast, luxurious, and visually striking presentation.

design_tokens.type_scale: Dramatic contrast with oversized, high-contrast serif display headings (vertical) and small, elegant sans-serif navigation and body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout, emphasizing precision and modern luxury.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, full-bleed sections with minimal content, creating a sense of spaciousness and focus on the product.

standout: The site's standout feature is its immersive, scroll-driven full-screen hero experience, where scrolling transitions between distinct product visuals and backgrounds while maintaining a persistent, large-scale vertical text element. This creates a highly dynamic and editorial feel, distinct from typical static hero sections.
